description: Externalized, auditable rule set consumed by the parsers. Changes here must be traceable to an entry in docs/lessons_learned.md (see 'lesson_ref').

coverage_thresholds.comment: ASIL-scaled minimums per ISO 26262-5 / ASPICE HWE.3-4 practice.

asil_architectural_metrics.comment: ISO 26262-5:2018 hardware architectural metric targets. SPFM/LFM per Clause 8 (Tables 4-5); PMHF per Clause 9 (Table 6), expressed in FIT (1 FIT = 1e-9/h). ASIL A has no architectural-metric target; null = not required.
